name: shadcn-navigation-menu
title: Navigation Menu
description: shadcn style-lane navigation menu wrapper backed by the existing Navigation Menu component.

export {
  arrowView,
  contentView,
  itemView,
  linkView,
  listView,
  popupView,
  portalView,
  positionerView,
  rootView,
  triggerView,
  viewportView,
} from "../navigation-menu";
export type {
  LinkViewConfig,
  NavigationMenuStyle,
  PartViewConfig,
  PortalViewConfig,
  TriggerViewConfig,
} from "../navigation-menu";

export {
  shadcnNavigationMenuArrowClassName,
  shadcnNavigationMenuContentClassName,
  shadcnNavigationMenuItemClassName,
  shadcnNavigationMenuLinkClassName,
  shadcnNavigationMenuListClassName,
  shadcnNavigationMenuPopupClassName,
  shadcnNavigationMenuPortalClassName,
  shadcnNavigationMenuPositionerClassName,
  shadcnNavigationMenuRootClassName,
  shadcnNavigationMenuTriggerClassName,
  shadcnNavigationMenuViewportClassName,
} from "./view";

export {
  navigationMenuArrowClassName as shadcnNavigationMenuArrowClassName,
  navigationMenuContentClassName as shadcnNavigationMenuContentClassName,
  navigationMenuItemClassName as shadcnNavigationMenuItemClassName,
  navigationMenuLinkClassName as shadcnNavigationMenuLinkClassName,
  navigationMenuListClassName as shadcnNavigationMenuListClassName,
  navigationMenuPopupClassName as shadcnNavigationMenuPopupClassName,
  navigationMenuPortalClassName as shadcnNavigationMenuPortalClassName,
  navigationMenuPositionerClassName as shadcnNavigationMenuPositionerClassName,
  navigationMenuRootClassName as shadcnNavigationMenuRootClassName,
  navigationMenuTriggerClassName as shadcnNavigationMenuTriggerClassName,
  navigationMenuViewportClassName as shadcnNavigationMenuViewportClassName,
} from "../navigation-menu/view";
